firstPlayerRule: Place all cars on the starting grid in random order; this sets player order for the first round. After everyone shifts gears and plays cards at the same time, the frontmost car moves first.
clarifications: Cars are placed one at a time, filling the grid spots in ascending order.
Each round, all players shift gears and play cards simultaneously. Then, starting with the frontmost car, closest to the Race Line, each car completes the rest of its turn in position order.
Legends (automated opponents) are added to the random draw for the starting grid.

In a Championship, the first race’s grid is drawn randomly. Later races follow the standings: the most Championship points takes pole position, and ties go to whoever was best positioned in the previous race.
